description: AI-H-04 harness scenario: exercises the M7 'Retreat when HP < 30%' contract. In the micro_breach scenario the reactive guard (id=2, hp=80, team='red') is the bot under test. The player (id=1) closes to engagement range and lays sustained rifle fire on the guard to drive its HP below the default 30% retreat threshold (per M7 spec § 'Cover seeking + suppression + retreat + squad comm + patrol' → 'Retreat decision: any archetype with HP < 30% OR squad dead → retreats to safe distance + cover'). 80hp × 30% = 24hp = retreat trigger window; with rifle damage_per_hit ≈ 20hp (rifle_m1_default), the guard reaches ~35% HP after ~3 hits then crosses the threshold on the next hit (~5% more damage), satisfying the feature description's 'spawn 1 bot at 35% HP, apply 5% damage' contract. Expected event sequence: control.command_accepted(act.player.fire) (repeated) → ai.cover_seeking_started{actor_id=2} → ai.suppression_started{suppressor=2} → ai.retreat_decision{actor_id=2, reason='hp_low', hp_fraction<=0.30}. The retreat reason string is 'hp_low' per spec literal. Final state: guard observed at HP fraction < 0.30 with retreat_decision recorded; player still firing; the guard's intent-label transitions away from Engage toward a retreat/cover-seek behavior. Per M7 spec § 'AI-H test harness preservation + extension' row `AI-H-04 | Retreat decision at HP threshold (M7; new)`. Run via `cargo run -p cf-e2e -- --scenario micro_breach --ai-harness ai_h_04_retreat_decision_at_hp_threshold`.
